question:
Identify the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Lenient
solution:
The correct answer is: **Strict**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"lenient"** means permissive, merciful, or tolerant. (उदार)

 
 
• **Example: **The teacher was **lenient **with the students who were late to class.
 
 
 
• **"Strict" **refers to enforcing rules or discipline rigidly, without leniency. (सख्त)
 
 
• **Example: **The school has a **strict **policy on attendance and punctuality.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'lenient' **is **'strict'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Kind **(दयालु): Having a friendly, generous, and considerate nature.

 
 
• **Example:** She is always very **kind **to animals.
 
 
 
• **Rowdy **(उपद्रवी): Noisy and disorderly.
 
 
• **Example: **The **rowdy **crowd disrupted the event.
 
 
 
• **Rude** (असभ्य): Offensively impolite or ill-mannered.
 
 
• **Example:** It is **rude **to interrupt someone while they are speaking.
